sites.name: OpenVibe.Chat
sites.tagline: One chat for the whole network.
sites.description: OpenVibe.Chat is the communication layer of the OpenVibe network: global rooms, stream chat, direct messages, group rooms, voice calls and text-to-speech — one identity, every conversation.
pillars: Rooms that span every OpenVibe site, with the same moderation tools everywhere.
DMs and group rooms tied to your OpenVibe account, not to one website.
Voice rooms and streamer-to-viewer calls, the same engine Live uses today.
Text-to-speech, soundboards and audio queues for streams and rooms.
meanwhile: The global chat is already live there — same account, same rules.
Voice rooms run inside Live's chat today.
sites.keywords: openvibe chat, community chat, voice rooms, direct messages, free speech chat

sites.name: OpenVibe.Codes
sites.description: OpenVibe.Codes is the developer portal of the OpenVibe network: API and SDK documentation, the service and capability registry, event schemas, mod publishing, starter templates and vibe-coding sessions.
pillars: One place for every OpenVibe API: identity, media, chat, live, community.
Service manifests, capability schemas and the event backbone, documented.
Publish mods and bots, start from templates, ship to the network.
Publish coding sessions and let people build alongside you.
meanwhile: Every OpenVibe service is open source. Read, fork, contribute.
The streaming API and ingest docs live on OpenVibe.Live today.
Formatters, encoders and validators on OpenVibe.Tools.
sites.keywords: openvibe api, openvibe sdk, developer portal, open source streaming api, mods

sites.name: OpenVibe.Blog
sites.description: OpenVibe.Blog is the publishing home of the OpenVibe network: the official OpenVibe blog and blogs for every member — drafts, scheduled posts, media-rich writing, comments and feeds, with your OpenVibe account.
pillars: Release notes, network updates and the story of the project.
A blog for every account: drafts, tags, media, scheduling.
Discussion through OpenVibe.Community; RSS for everyone.
Your network theme is your blog theme, if you want it to be.
meanwhile: Share text and code today on OpenVibe.Community.
sites.keywords: openvibe blog, community blog, open source blogging

sites.name: OpenVibe.Wiki
sites.description: OpenVibe.Wiki is the knowledge space of the OpenVibe network: wiki spaces you can build and edit together, source-backed and AI-assisted, with page trees, citations, media and discussion.
pillars: A wiki space per topic, game, community or project.
Every generated page carries its sources; every edit is yours.
meanwhile: The streaming docs are the first wiki-like space of the network.
sites.keywords: openvibe wiki, community wiki, knowledge base

sites.name: OpenVibe.News
sites.description: OpenVibe.News aggregates the news with transparency: sourced stories, summaries that show their sources, multiple angles side by side, topic pages and framing you control — not an algorithm you can't see.
pillars: Every summary links to what it was built from.
Read the same story from several perspectives, side by side.
You choose the lens; nothing is chosen for you silently.
Follow topics across sources, with your OpenVibe account.
sites.keywords: openvibe news, transparent news, news aggregation, multiple perspectives

sites.name: OpenVibe.Reviews
sites.description: OpenVibe.Reviews gathers what people say about products, services, employers, hosts and communities across many sources — with provenance, without fake ratings — and lets the community discuss it.
pillars: One page per product, service or place, built from many sources.
Every quote links back to where it was said.
meanwhile: Community threads are the first stop.
sites.keywords: openvibe reviews, review aggregation, honest reviews

sites.name: OpenVibe.Tips
sites.description: OpenVibe.Tips is the tipping and alerts layer of the OpenVibe network: tips, donation goals, superchats, paid text-to-speech and media requests, with alert overlays for creators.
pillars: Tip a creator, fund a goal, see it land on stream.
Paid messages read out on stream, through OpenVibe.Chat.
Overlays for OBS and the browser, themed with the network.
Every transaction on the network's own ledger, visible to you.
meanwhile: Tips already work on Live today.
sites.keywords: openvibe tips, tip streamers, donation alerts, superchat

sites.name: OpenVibe.VIP
sites.description: OpenVibe.VIP is the membership layer of the OpenVibe network: creator memberships, channel subscriptions, VIP tiers and perks that unlock across Live, Community, Blog and more.
pillars: Subscribe to the people you watch; perks follow you everywhere.
One membership that supports the whole network.
Badges, emotes, early access, gated posts — set by creators.
What it costs and where it goes, in the open.
meanwhile: Channel subscriptions exist on Live today.

sites.name: OpenVibe.Trade
sites.description: OpenVibe.Trade is the market intelligence room of the OpenVibe network: watchlists, alerts, summaries and community discussion for markets, collectibles and deals — information and tools, never advice.
pillars: Track what you care about, get told when it moves.
What happened and why, with sources.
Tools and information only — always labelled as such.
meanwhile: Deal discovery is the sibling room.
sites.keywords: openvibe trade, watchlists, market alerts, community trading tools

sites.name: OpenVibe.Host
sites.description: OpenVibe.Host is the hosting and deployment surface of the OpenVibe network: deploy OpenVibe services, bots, mods and static sites, with TLS, DNS and logs handled for you.
pillars: Every OpenVibe service, deployable in one step.
Host your bot or mod next to the network it talks to.
A folder in, a domain out, with TLS.
The same deploy tooling the network runs on.
meanwhile: Every service ships its own deploy scripts on GitHub.
sites.keywords: openvibe host, hosting, deployment, self-hosting openvibe

sites.name: OpenVibe.Deals
sites.description: OpenVibe.Deals is community deal discovery for the OpenVibe network: deals people vote on, hotness that reflects real interest, keyword alerts, price comparisons and honest discussion.
pillars: Deals rise because people like them.
Tell it what you want; it tells you when it is cheap.
meanwhile: The coupon room is the sibling of this one.
sites.keywords: openvibe deals, community deals, deal alerts

sites.name: OpenVibe.Coupons
sites.description: OpenVibe.Coupons is community-checked coupon discovery: codes matched to stores, validity reported by real people, expirations tracked, and a browser helper on the way.
pillars: Codes that worked, codes that didn't, reported honestly.
The right codes for the store you are on.
Apply codes where you shop — coming with the site.
meanwhile: Deal discovery is the sibling of this room.
sites.keywords: openvibe coupons, coupon codes, community coupons

sites.name: OpenRe.Stream
sites.tagline: Ingest and restream, in the open.
sites.description: OpenRe.Stream is the ingest and restream infrastructure behind OpenVibe.Live: RTMP, WHIP and SRT ingest, stream lifecycle, restream destinations and output status — the plumbing, documented and open.
pillars: RTMP, WHIP/WebRTC and SRT, with keys and lifecycle in one place.
Twitch, YouTube, Kick, SRT and RobotStreamer destinations.
Live acknowledgement, errors relayed in plain words, uptime.
Run it yourself; the code is on GitHub.
meanwhile: Ingest and restreaming run inside Live today.
sites.keywords: openre stream, rtmp ingest, whip, srt, restream, open source streaming infrastructure
